$comment: Kodukeel API v1 (ADR-029). Generated by `npm run api:schema` from lib/api/contract.ts and lib/api/draft.ts; do not edit. A route marked draft may still change. A response may gain fields within v1, so a client ignores fields it does not know.

body.description: Every refusal from a v1 route, whatever its status.

GET /api/v1/meta.summary: The API version, the oldest native build still answered, what is switched off, the speech model's pins and how to sign in.

response.description: What this installation is, for a native app before it signs in. Nothing about any person.

GET /api/v1/me.summary: Who the token belongs to, and the language they read the app in.

GET /api/v1/review.summary: Today's review sitting, as the web's review session receives it.

items.description: One run of a sentence, with the dictionary entry it was vouched as, if any.

intro.description: What to show the first time this word is met; null on a card already seen.

anyOf.description: A meaning as the learner's language leads it; the English is never dropped while an equivalent leads.

items.description: A meaning as the learner's language leads it; the English is never dropped while an equivalent leads.

scheduling.description: A card's scheduling, as a grade leaves it and as undo puts it back.

items.description: One card of a review sitting, as the web's review session receives it.

nextDue.description: When the next card comes back, on an empty sitting alone; the line is in the learner's language.

waitingOnCourse.description: Whether unseen cards are held back until the course reaches them.

response.description: Today's review sitting: due cards, then a capped trickle of new ones, held to what the course has taught.

POST /api/v1/grades.summary: One grade or a batch, idempotent by id, as the offline outbox replays them.

id.description: The id the device chose for this answer, before it asked. Sending it twice records it once.

reviewedAt.description: Epoch milliseconds on the device, clamped by the server to the last thirty days and to never after it heard.

slot.description: What the round asked about, where narrower than the card; checked against a closed list.

reachedSlot.description: The form that came back instead, where the round could name one.

spoken.description: True only where the answer marked is what the recognizer heard, word for word.

settled.description: Every id the client may now drop: recorded now, recorded before, or never recordable.

anyOf.description: A card's scheduling, as a grade leaves it and as undo puts it back.

scheduling.description: What this request left the card at, or null where it wrote nothing now.

results.description: One entry per grade written by this request, in the order they were applied.

POST /api/v1/grades/undo.summary: A card's scheduling put back; the review log is untouched.

previous.description: The scheduling the card had before the grade being taken back, as the grade's own answer gave it.

GET /api/v1/today.summary: Whether today is a lesson, a check, the web or nothing.

GET /api/v1/lessons/{id}.summary: One lesson, as the web's lesson screen receives it.

POST /api/v1/lessons/{id}/finish.summary: A finished lesson: today ticked and its words in the deck.

GET /api/v1/checks/{id}.summary: One attempt's paper at a part's check.

POST /api/v1/checks/{id}.summary: An attempt marked on the server.

spoken.description: Counts only, never the words heard. `unseen` is true only where the line answered was hidden on screen.

POST /api/v1/scenes/{runId}/help.summary: Help asked for in a conversation.

POST /api/v1/chat.summary: Today's chat begun, where a model is configured.

POST /api/v1/deck.summary: A word kept, starred, put aside or brought back.

POST /api/v1/speech/forms.summary: Which heard words are Estonian spellings.

GET /api/v1/recordings.summary: The native speaker's clips and the text each answers for.

key.description: The text `nativeFor` finds this clip by, or null where it is played only by id.

atOwnSpeed.description: Played at the speed it was said, never at the learner's pace.

request.description: Draft: every field optional, each validated as its Settings action validates it.

response.description: The backup the web's export downloads.
